name: Plan review precedence: research plan proposed before launching subagents
purpose: Verifies that after clarifying questions are answered, the deep-research skill in interview mode proposes the 2-5 research aspects and requests feedback without executing biomcp research queries.
prompt: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill: I am replying to your Step 1 clarifying questions for deep research on CAR-T therapy safety in solid tumors. Scope: focus on CRS, neurotoxicity, and on-target/off-tumor toxicities in glioblastoma and ovarian cancer from 2021-2026 clinical trials and peer-reviewed literature; standard report format. Now proceed to Step 2: decompose the topic and propose your research area plan for my review.

checks.desc: the final assistant message must propose structured research aspects
the final assistant message must invite user feedback or adjustments
zero evidence queries before user provides plan review feedback
